preheader: Your founding agency partner place is secured. Here is how to unlock it.
title: Hi {{first_name}}, you are in. 🎉

blocks.html: Your place as one of the founding agency partners is secured. You paid {{amount_paid}} for the year, renewing {{renewal_date}}, at a rate that is locked for as long as you stay a partner.
Create your AIWA account using {{partner_email}}. That exact address is what unlocks your founding partner plan automatically.
Then join the founders community and book your private onboarding call. Both are on your welcome page.
Keep this link, it is where your onboarding lives.
